        physics_significance.append(physics_significance[-1] + c)
        physics_width.append(physics_width[-1] + w)
    
    for c, w in informatics_cups:
        informatics_significance.append(informatics_significance[-1] + c)
        informatics_width.append(informatics_width[-1] + w)

        j = bisect.bisect_right(informatics_width, remaining_width)
        
        # Calculate the total significance
        total_significance = physics_significance[i] + informatics_significance[j]
        
        # Update the maximum significance
        max_significance = max(max_significance, total_significance)
    
    return max_significance
